Initial release of aftersale-sop:

- Provides standardized after-sales service SOPs covering returns, complaint handling, escalation, service recovery, compensation, quality monitoring, and training.
- Accepts core business, policy, and team information as inputs to generate tailored workflows and guidelines.
- Outputs clear procedures and metrics for consistent, efficient post-purchase support.
